page_title: Rajendra Prasad N - AWS Databricks Cloud Engineer
headline: Cloud Engineer | AWS, Databricks, Apache Spark, ETL/ELT, and Data Platforms
summary_html: Cloud Engineer with 10+ years of experience designing and operating scalable AWS-based data platforms for analytics, ETL/ELT, and cloud data engineering workflows. Strong hands-on expertise with AWS EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, Glue, Redshift, VPC, Databricks, Apache Spark, Python, SQL, Terraform, CloudFormation, Jenkins, and GitHub Actions. Experienced in building Databricks data pipelines, incremental ingestion frameworks, Spark-based transformations, Redshift-centric warehousing flows, infrastructure as code, CI/CD automation, observability, governance, and cost-aware production operations across multi-account AWS environments.

achievements.text: Designed AWS data platform foundations using EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, VPC, Glue, Redshift, and private networking controls for scalable analytics and governed data processing.
Built Databricks pipelines with Apache Spark, Auto Loader, Delta-based processing, and scheduled jobs for batch and incremental ingestion, transformation, and serving workflows.
Implemented ETL/ELT patterns for ingesting data from cloud storage and operational databases into Redshift and Databricks environments to support reporting, analytics, and downstream consumers.
Automated platform deployment with Terraform, CloudFormation, Jenkins, and GitHub Actions for Databricks workspaces, jobs, clusters, AWS resources, and data pipeline assets.
Improved performance, reliability, security, and cost efficiency through monitoring, autoscaling, job-cluster tuning, private endpoints, Secrets Manager integration, and environment governance.

experience.title: Lead Cloud Engineer
impact: Designed and maintained AWS infrastructure for cloud-based data platforms using EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, VPC, IAM, Terraform, and CloudFormation across multiple production environments.
Built Databricks-based ETL and ELT workflows using Apache Spark, Python, and SQL to ingest, transform, and publish analytics-ready datasets for downstream reporting and business use cases.

Implemented incremental ingestion patterns from Amazon S3 into Delta tables using Databricks Auto Loader, checkpointing, and schema-evolution controls to support high-volume batch and near-real-time processing.
Engineered Spark SQL and PySpark transformations for curated bronze, silver, and gold data layers, improving data quality, query performance, and downstream usability for analysts and data engineers.
Integrated Databricks pipelines with Amazon Redshift and Redshift Serverless to support warehousing, SQL-based analytics, and governed consumption of curated datasets.
Used AWS Glue for metadata handling, ETL orchestration support, and integration with S3 and Redshift-oriented data flows in multi-account environments.
Automated deployment of Databricks workspaces, clusters, jobs, notebooks, secrets, and AWS dependencies using Terraform modules, GitHub Actions, and gated CI/CD workflows.
Implemented private networking patterns with VPC endpoints, PrivateLink, security groups, and Secrets Manager to secure Databricks and AWS data services in regulated environments.
Monitored cloud and data platform health with CloudWatch dashboards, audit logs, job alerts, and operational telemetry to improve reliability, incident response, and SLA adherence.
Optimized platform cost and performance by standardizing autoscaling cluster policies, job-cluster usage, workload scheduling, storage lifecycle controls, and environment right-sizing.
Partnered with data engineers, analysts, and business teams to define ingestion requirements, tune delivery schedules, troubleshoot pipeline failures, and support production analytics workloads.

Developed Python and SQL transformations for ingestion, cleansing, enrichment, and aggregation of semi-structured and relational data sets.

Worked with data engineering and analytics teams to support new source onboarding, SQL data models, and warehouse delivery timelines.
Contributed to performance tuning for Spark jobs and Redshift loads by improving partitioning, file layout, SQL execution patterns, and job parallelism.
